headline: The Badminton Association of India announced India's contingent for the 2026 Asian Games, starring PV Sindhu, Lakshya Sen and the Satwik‑Chirag pair as the flagship athletes.
India women's cricket team clinched qualification for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics after winning the decisive series, securing the nation's spot at the upcoming Games.
Balwinder Dhaliwal, the celebrated Asian Games shot put champion, has died at the age of 67, leaving a lasting legacy in Indian athletics.
Farmer’s daughter Anushka Yadav shattered a national record, becoming the youngest Indian athlete ever to set a track‑and‑field mark.
